title: Downtime decoded
caption: Downtime is the recovery window after a treatment — but clinics often use the word differently, so it's worth knowing what it actually covers. At minimum it means redness or swelling that fades in hours. At the other end, it means avoiding sun, sweat, and social plans for days or weeks. The real question to ask is: downtime from what, exactly — exercise, makeup, work, or being seen in public? Each has a different answer, and they don't always match. Knowing that turns a vague warning into a checklist you can actually plan around. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
